native_routes: /api/forecasts (list; session cookie -> user id via HMAC session hash)
/api/forecasts/{id} (detail: snapshot projection, market LMSR view, eligibility, points, registry PDA status, attestation)
forwarded: every other path via service binding LEGACY -> forecast-network (Python Worker)

parity.method: GET each native route on workers.dev edge and on the Python custom domain; compare JSON bodies minus serverTime/version and the security headers
parity.result: SAME for /api/status, /api/health, /api/risk/feeds/devnet-stable-risk-v2, /api/risk/v2/feeds/devnet-stable-risk-v2; invalid feed id -> 400 invalid_request on both

cutover: wrangler deploy (non-TTY) moves the custom domain with override_existing_origin; apps/web/wrangler.jsonc no longer declares routes so Python deploys cannot reclaim it
rollback: add routes back to apps/web/wrangler.jsonc and run scripts/deploy_web.py (non-TTY override moves the domain back)
post_cutover_checks: POST /api/forecasts with Origin reaches authentication_required (origin passthrough)
root, app.js, docs pages served from edge assets

forecasts_parity.method: 18 query combinations (sorts, categories, search escapes, cursors, invalid inputs) against forecast-network-edge-preview vs forecast-network on workers.dev; bodies compared minus clocks

forecasts_load.note: D1 candidate scoring dominates; route is database-bound on both

detail_parity.method: 17 ids (OPEN/CHALLENGE/FINALIZED states + missing/invalid ids) preview edge vs Python on workers.dev
detail_parity.result: 17/17 SAME bodies and status codes; Python intermittently returned Cloudflare 1101 on one id while the edge stayed 200

reads_parity.method: 43 paths (anonymous) preview edge vs Python on workers.dev
reads_parity.result: 39/43 byte-equal; the 4 differences were 3 Python Cloudflare 1101 flakes (edge 200) and creator consistency windows that embed the request clock
